slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
fearlessly self possessed

solo museum trips

visit a museum alone and spend as long as you like in front of one painting. enjoying your own company in a public place is one of the quietest forms of confidence.

open mic nights

sign up to read a poem or tell a short story at an open mic, just once. the fear beforehand is huge, and the pride afterwards lasts much longer than the fear did.

learning to box

take a beginner boxing class once a week. learning that you can take a hit and keep going changes how you stand in every room, long after you leave the gym.

curious mornings

spend 5 minutes every morning learning something new: a myth, a planet, a famous painter. walking into the day with something interesting in your head makes you steady.

dancing classes

join a dance class where you have to move in front of strangers. looking a bit silly on purpose is the fastest way to stop being afraid of looking silly.
